_about: Singapore towns (for areas and service boundaries), the real language mix of people (for spoken sets and agent talk), and the six app languages. Sources: Singapore Dept of Statistics profile (approximate shares), operator pages.

town_notes.heartland_elders: Most seeded elders live in HDB heartland towns: Ang Mo Kio, Toa Payoh, Bedok, Tampines, Hougang, Yishun, Jurong West, Bukit Merah
town_notes.service_boundary: Each AAC serves one or two towns - a person joins the centre nearest their estate
town_notes.new_towns: Punggol, Sengkang, Bukit Panjang have newer centres with younger-old residents (50s-60s)

languages_of_people.note: many rural-heritage elders speak dialect at home; Mandarin is the bridge language
Bahasa Melayu is both home language and national language
includes long-settled families and newer migrants
ko is not one of the six app languages yet - talk in English unless extended

notes: The six app languages cover Singapore's main groups (English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Chinese, Malay). Dialect and Korean speakers talk in the closest supported language - the agent asks, never guesses.
